New concept 'gestational_weight_gain_counseling' (behavioral counseling on healthy gestational weight gain) was introduced because no vocabulary concept fits. Counseling documentation may not be reliably coded in structured EHR data, so a reviewer may prefer to treat the numerator as uncomputable.
Whether the counseling is 'effective' (content, intensity, number of sessions) cannot be represented. The rule checks only that counseling was documented.

The text gives no timing for the counseling. The measurement-year window is an assumption and is declared as derived. Aligning the window to the pregnancy episode (onset to delivery) cannot be expressed with the available pregnancy concept.
The recommendation is to 'offer' counseling. Whether the patient accepted or declined the offer cannot be represented.
